    BibTexEntry
    BibTexEntriesController.saveCommentsDraft(String id, Long projectId)
    Promotes an entry's draft comments to be its published comments: copies CITELINES_comments_draft into CITELINES_comments, then removes the draft field.
    BibTexEntry
    BibTexEntriesController.updateAbstract(String id, Long projectId, String newAbstract)
    Updates just the abstract field of a BibTeX entry, leaving every other field untouched — a narrower alternative to BibTexEntriesController.updateBibTexEntry(java.lang.String, java.lang.Long, java.lang.String) for BibTexEntryShowPage's Abstract card, useful when the abstract comes from a different source than the rest of the entry (see issue #79).
    BibTexEntry
    BibTexEntriesController.updateBibTexEntry(String id, Long projectId, String rawBibTex)
    Re-parses edited BibTeX text (which must contain exactly one entry) and replaces the stored entry with the same id.
    BibTexEntry
    BibTexEntriesController.upsertCommentsDraft(String id, Long projectId, String draft)
    Upserts the draft comments (CITELINES_comments_draft) for a BibTeX entry, leaving the published comments (CITELINES_comments) untouched.
